name: Gójar (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green, the outer stripes twice the width of the white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gójar (a tree and a hill above waves).
history: Gójar adopted its arms and flag officially on 21 March 2006; for centuries it had used arms reproducing those of King Philip V. The flag is a cloth of 3:2 divided into three horizontal stripes, the first and third twice the width of the central one, blue, white and green.

features.role: Gójar arms — tree and hill above waves
